data.title: Research Frontiers Welcomes Gauzy’s Court-Approved Restructuring and the Restart of SPD-Smart Light Control Film Production
data.description: Woodbury, New York, on September 18, 2026 - Research Frontiers Inc. (Nasdaq: REFR), known for its patented SPD-SmartGlass technology, acknowledged the approval from Gauzy Ltd. regarding the final court approval of its debt settlement plan. This plan garnered support from creditors holding 98.96% of voting claims, with secured lenders unanimously approving the settlement. This significant milestone marks progress in Gauzy's financial restructuring efforts.

data.title: Generation Mining Agrees to a Term Sheet with the Ontario Government for Funding to Support Construction of the Marathon Processing Facility
data.description: In Toronto, Generation Mining Limited (TSX: GENM) (OTCQB: GENMF) has announced a positive development. The company agreed to a non-binding term sheet with the Government of Ontario for the construction of a mineral processing facility at its Marathon Copper-Palladium Project in Northwestern Ontario. The terms outline a loan of up to $11 million through Ontario’s Critic program to support this initiative. This collaboration marks a significant step forward for Generation Mining's 100%-owned Marathon Project.
